career_path_block.路径: Assistant Architects, Except Landscape And Naval

career_risk_cards.callout: The largest career risk is not AI but market cycles combined with heavy responsibility. Projects decline, drawings carry liability, and BIM reduces drafting work.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest career risk is not AI but market cycles combined with heavy responsibility. Property downturns reduce projects, signed drawings carry substantial liability, and revisions seem endless. BIM and generative design also automate some drafting and rendering.
risks: Property downturns reduce projects
Heavy responsibility for signed drawings and endless revisions
BIM reduces routine drafting
Generative tools replace some rendering
Market cycles create unstable income

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable systems become, architects still decide whether a design fits a historic street and how details work on site. People must see the context, negotiate the outcome, and sign the drawings.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「周期波动 + 责任重」——项目少了、图要担责，制图还被 BIM 吃。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「周期波动 + 责任重」——地产下行项目少了，且图签责任大、改图无穷；同时 BIM 与生成式设计在吃掉部分制图与效果图工作。
risks: 地产下行，项目减少
图签责任重，改图无穷
BIM 吃常规制图
生成式替部分效果图
周期波动，收入不稳

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，那版和老街对不对脾气、现场节点怎么落地，最后还是建筑师的眼去看、嘴去扯、手去签——设计这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.路径: Only watches screens without making decisions

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but automation + narrow responsibility. Screen-only monitoring is easiest to replace; process decisions and safety expertise create stability.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risks are automation + heavy accountability. DCS and advanced control absorb some monitoring, while safety and environmental responsibility remain substantial. People who move toward process optimization + safety are more stable; pure monitoring roles face replacement.
risks: Advanced control absorbs monitoring
Heavy safety and environmental responsibility
Demanding plant conditions
Replacement of pure monitoring roles
Cyclical fluctuations

page.contract_project_risk_block: Regardless of how well a system tunes parameters, engineers still inspect, judge, and sign off on whether the plant can start and whether safety controls are sufficient. People cannot be fully removed from process safety.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动化 + 责任单一」——只盯屏最易被替，向工艺决策与安全转才稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「自动化 + 责任重」——中控 DCS 与先进控制吃部分监控，且安全环保责任大；向「工艺优化 + 安全」走的人更稳，纯监屏型易被替。
risks: 先进控制吃监屏
安全环保责任重
现场环境考验
纯监屏型被替
周期波动

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多会调参，那装置能不能开、安全兜不兜得住，最后还是工程师的眼去巡、脑去判、手去签——工艺安全这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Depends on one installed equipment base
Covers ATMs, point-of-sale systems, and printers
Lead teams and manage response times

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is changing demand, not AI. ATMs and copiers decline, while self-service terminals and smart equipment expand. Technicians who keep pace continue to find work.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest career risk is not AI but changing equipment formats. ATM numbers are shrinking in some markets, and digital offices replace traditional copiers. Demand gradually disappears for technicians who only repair legacy equipment.
risks: Demand contraction: traditional ATM and copier markets are shrinking
Skill transition: legacy-machine specialists face marginalization
Demanding travel: field repairs span multiple sites
Income ceiling: frontline advancement depends on leading teams
Bid pressure: outsourced service providers compete on price

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can read fault codes and dispatch work orders, but technicians still need to open equipment, inspect it directly, and repair the cause of repeated jams. This career guidance is for exploration only, not a diagnosis, hiring decision, or guarantee of outcomes.

responsibilities: Respond to repair tickets and diagnose faults remotely
Disassemble equipment on site and replace components
Record work orders and manage parts
skills: Work order and spare parts management

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「需求形态在变」——ATM 少了、复印机被替代了，但自助终端和智慧设备多了，跟得上的人永远有活干。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「设备形态在变」——ATM 数量在部分市场持续收缩，传统复印机被数字化办公替代，如果只会修老设备，需求会慢慢消失。
risks: 需求收缩：传统 ATM 和复印机市场在缩
技能换代：只修老机型会被边缘化
奔波辛苦：上门维修跨网点跑
收入天花板：一线岗位晋升靠带团队
竞标压力：外包服务商拼价格

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能读出故障码、自动派工单，但「这台设备为什么反复卡纸」的背后原因，还得维修工亲手拆开、亲眼看到、亲手修好。

responsibilities: 响应报修并远程初判故障

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is automation + rising precision demands. Machines take over insertion work, and workers who do not learn soldering or testing face the greatest danger.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risks are automation + rising precision demands. Automated placement and assembly lines remove many standard roles while products become more integrated. Workers who cannot adjust equipment or learn new processes face the greatest risk.
risks: Automated placement reduces standard roles
Products become more integrated
Production-line work is detailed and repetitive
Cold joints and missing components bring accountability
Insertion-only roles are vulnerable to replacement

page.contract_project_risk_block: Regardless of how capable automated placement becomes, people still solder, repair cold joints, and set testing parameters. Electronics assembly cannot remove people completely.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险是「自动化 + 精度内卷」——插件被机器吃，不学焊接不钻调试的人最危险。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「自动化 + 精度内卷」——自动贴片和装配线吃掉大量标准岗，同时产品集成度越来越高，不会调设备、不学新工艺的人最危险。
risks: 自动贴片吃标准岗
产品集成度越来越高
产线精细枯燥
虚焊漏装追责
纯插件易被替

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多会贴片，焊还是人焊的、虚焊还是人修的、调试还是人定的——电子这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.可控: Use AI for speed, shift toward judgment

career_risk_cards.callout: Risk stays manageable as long as you do not overstep your scope and keep learning. The moat for Fashion Designers lies in execution and judgment, not repetitive labor.
career_risk_cards.fact: The biggest risk in this role is not AI but medium-risk exposure combined with scope of responsibility. Judgment and final review for Fashion Designers still rest with people; AI only handles structurable tasks.
risks: Accountability and compliance pressure in fashion design.
Structurable tasks are being replaced faster by AI.
Industry swings and tighter headcount or posts.
Knowledge turns over quickly and needs constant refreshing.
Communication overhead in cross-role collaboration.

page.contract_project_risk_block: Split moderate risk into what you can learn and what you can control: methods are learnable, process and compliance are controllable.

responsibilities: Take responsibility for the quality and risks of fashion-design outputs.
Coordinate resources and deliver fashion-design projects.
Review and improve fashion-design processes and methods.

skills.说明: Use AI and professional software well

career_path_block.可控: 用 AI 提效、转向判断

career_risk_cards.callout: 风险可控的前提是「不越责任边界 + 持续补课」——时装设计师的护城河在执行与判断，不在重复劳动。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大风险不在 AI，而在「中风险敞口 + 责任边界」——时装设计师的判断与终审仍由人承担，AI 只处理可结构化任务。
risks: Fashion Designers领域的责任与合规边界压力。
可结构化任务被 AI 加速替代。
行业波动与编制/岗位收紧。
知识更新快，需持续补课。
跨角色协作的沟通成本。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 把中风险拆成「可学 + 可控」两块：可学的是方法，可控的是流程与合规。

responsibilities: 制定与执行Fashion Designers相关的工作方案。
对Fashion Designers产出质量与风险负责。
协调资源、推动Fashion Designers项目交付。
复盘优化Fashion Designers流程与方法。

career_path_block.说明: Master's degree accepted, with a somewhat lower threshold
Growing demand in the field's transition direction

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but university evaluation and disciplinary transition. Up-or-out review is real, and faculty whose courses remain limited to traditional library science can fall behind the field.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but faculty lines and research evaluation. Up-or-out pressure, firm publication requirements, and enrollment-driven staffing volatility determine job security more directly than AI.
risks: Intense competition for faculty lines and strong up-or-out pressure
Doctoral credentials are a firm threshold, with long and costly training
Traditional library science programs have limited enrollment and few roles
Strong research-evaluation pressure, with publications and grants as firm requirements
Faculty who do not update courses risk disciplinary marginalization

page.contract_project_risk_block: However capable AI becomes at generating literature reviews, scholarly judgment, classroom interaction, and research supervision must remain human. AI supplies drafts, but people decide whether a question is worth pursuing.

responsibilities: Teach library and information science courses
Conduct academic research and apply for grants
Contribute to program development and teaching reform

career_path_block.说明: 学科转型方向，需求上升

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「高校考核与学科转型」——非升即走是现实压力，课程还停留在传统图书馆学的老师，会被学科方向甩下。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「高校编制与科研考核」——非升即走的压力、发表论文的硬指标、招生规模收缩带来的岗位波动，这些比 AI 更直接地决定饭碗。
risks: 高校编制竞争激烈，非升即走压力大
博士学历是硬门槛，读博周期长成本高
传统图书馆学专业招生规模有限，岗位少
科研考核压力大，论文课题是硬指标
课程不转型的老师，面临学科边缘化

page.contract_project_risk_block: 无论 AI 多会生成综述，学术判断、课堂互动、研究指导这些环节都得留在人手上——AI 给初稿，但「值不值得做」的判断，永远是人的。

responsibilities: 讲授图书情报专业课程
指导本科生与研究生论文
开展学术研究与申报课题
参与学科建设与教学改革

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is smart-meter replacement. Pure on-site reading is easiest to replace, while movement into inspection and customer service improves stability.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is smart-meter replacement. Automatic remote meter reading reduces pure on-site reading roles, while anomaly verification, in-home visits, and equipment inspections still require people. Workers who combine inspection and customer-service skills remain more resilient, while pure readers face replacement.
risks: Smart meters replace readings
On-site roles shrink
Outdoor fieldwork in sun and rain
Low skill threshold
Pure reading roles face replacement

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how well smart meters read themselves, meter readers still use their eyes, legs, and hands to inspect blocked covers and unusual reading jumps. People cannot be fully removed from on-site verification.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险是「智能表替代」——只现场读数最易被替，向巡检客服转才稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「智能表替代」——远程自动抄表普及，纯现场读数岗在缩；但异常复核、入户与设备巡检仍需人。向「巡检 + 客服」复合走的人更稳，纯读数型易被替。
risks: 智能表替代读数
现场岗在缩
日晒雨淋外勤
技能门槛低
纯读数型被替

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管智能表多会自读，那表盖被挡、读数跳异常，最后还是抄表员的眼去看、腿去跑、手去记——现场核查这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but credentials and regulation. Scope of practice varies by location, while people with strong assessment and compliance skills are more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI, but credentials and regulation. The scope of practice varies across countries, and digital tools are absorbing some search work, but in-person consultation and individualized plans still depend on people.
risks: Inconsistent credentialing regulations
Search work diverted by digital tools
Restricted scope of practice
Slow results can cause patient attrition
Difficulty building trust

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how smart systems become, physicians still have to use judgment, explain recommendations, and set plans to decide who needs which adjustments, how to individualize treatment, and how to follow the course. People cannot be fully removed from this work.

responsibilities: Track treatment courses and conduct follow-up visits

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「资质与监管」——执业范围各地不同，有辨证力和合规意识的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「资质与监管」——执业范围各国不一，且部分检索被数字化；但面诊与个体化方案仍靠人。
risks: 资质监管不一
检索被数字化分流
执业边界受限
见效慢易流失
信任建立难

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪类人该调、怎么定个体化方案、疗程怎么跟，最后还是医师的脑去辨、嘴去讲、手去定——调理这头，人撤不干净。
